# qualys_was_finding_ignore (Resource)

Declares a Qualys WAS finding ignored — a genuine accepted risk or
confirmed false positive, with `comment` as the audit-trail justification.
Deleting this resource reopens the finding.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qualys_was_findings" "storefront_active" {
  web_app_id = qualys_web_application.storefront.id
  status     = "ACTIVE"
}

resource "qualys_was_finding_ignore" "known_false_positive" {
  finding_id = one([
    for f in data.qualys_was_findings.storefront_active.findings :
    f.id if f.qid == "150012"
  ])
  comment = "False positive, verified by security team on 2026-08-16."
}
```

## Why not `fix` too?

A user-supplied "Findings Lifecycle Actions" walkthrough confirms `fix`
(`POST fix/was/finding/<id>`) alongside `ignore`/`reopen`, but the same
source explicitly recommends against using lifecycle actions as a
substitute for rescanning: "fixed" is meant to be scan-verified — a later
scan can revert the status if the vulnerability is still detected — not
administratively declared the way an accepted risk or false-positive
`ignore` legitimately is. That doesn't fit this provider's declarative
resource model, so only `ignore`/`reopen` are exposed as a managed
resource.

## Findings aren't created by Terraform

A finding is discovered by a scan, not created here. Find the `finding_id`
via `data.qualys_was_findings`, then bring its ignored state under
management with this resource (or `terraform import`).

If Qualys reports the finding as no longer ignored — most plausibly a
rescan rediscovered it — this resource is removed from state on the next
`terraform plan`/`apply`, so a subsequent apply re-ignores it rather than
state silently disagreeing with reality.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- **finding_id** (String) ID of the WAS finding to ignore (see `data.qualys_was_findings`).
- **comment** (String) Justification for ignoring this finding. Sent again on every change, so editing it updates the recorded reason.

### Read-Only

- **id** (String) The ID of this resource (the finding ID).
- **qid** (String)
- **name** (String)
- **url** (String)
- **severity** (Number)
- **status** (String)

## Import

```shell
terraform import qualys_was_finding_ignore.known_false_positive 9284112
```
